state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 10 (the feature proofs) is under way.** Stages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 are done; Stage 4 lacks only a CA a program supplies, and Stage 6 lacks only wiring the schema into the readers. `Core\Ldap`, `Core\Ldap\Filter`, `Core\Ldap\Dn`, `Core\Ldap\Sid`, `Core\Ldap\Ad` and `Core\Ldap\Change` owe nothing.

**Six of the 17 `Core\Ldap\Entry` members owe nothing: `dn`, `has`, `string`, `strings`, `bytes` and `toArray`.** Each has `about.md`, three examples with `.out`, one attack and one bench with a recorded figure. Every member has its tests proof (`every_entry_reader_reads_its_own_form` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs` and six `ldap-*.nvst` cases). The other 11 still owe `about.md`, three examples, one attack and one bench: `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Ldap\Entry'` lists them.

**The three proof trees are granted `[ldap.corp]` by directory.** The root `nvs.toml` has one `[[app]] root` block each for `docs/examples/core/Ldap-Entry`, `tests/hostile/core/Ldap-Entry` and `benches/members/core/Ldap-Entry`, so a new member's programs need no grant edit. `bun nv try` copies a snippet into `.agent-tmp/`, where no grant reaches; run a draft with `target/covws/<triple>/debug/nvs.exe run <path>` from inside one of the three trees instead.

**The `samba-ad` domain is seeded.** The `20-novis-seed` script in `tests/db/compose.yaml` writes `OU=Company` (its comment lists every user, group and password). `[ldap.corp]` binds over LDAPS at `localhost:16636` as the read-only `CN=Reader,OU=Company,DC=example,DC=test`. Every program carries `// requires: samba-ad`. `docs/examples/core/Ldap-Entry/string/` is the model for an example, an attack and a bench.

**Seeded facts a proof can print:** `carla.diaz` has `mustChangePassword` and a computed `passwordExpired`, `dora.lind` is `disabled`, `ben.kohl` has `passwordNeverExpires`, `Newsletter` is a distribution group with `mail`, and `Employees`/`Managers` are global security groups. Only `anna.berg` has a `title`; `Reader` has no `memberOf` and no `mail`.

**Traps for a live proof.** A search returns entries in no fixed order, and GUIDs, SIDs and timestamps differ per boot, so an example sorts what it prints and never prints those. A catch variable or a `var` reused in one file with another type does not compile (E0406). An error's text is `->message`, and `!==` does not exist.

items.text: **The typed readers `int`, `bool`, `uuid`, `sid`, `sids`, `instant`, `duration` and `isDeleted` owe nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). They are at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:138` onwards and `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:708`. `isDeleted` needs `showDeleted: true`, which the read-only `Reader` may not be allowed; check that before writing its examples.

**The AD readers `accountFlags`, `groupType` and `accountType` owe nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`), at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:210` to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/value.rs:236`.

backlog: `Core\Ldap\Connection::setPassword`, `changePassword` and `compare` owe every proof but tests (`bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Ldap\Connection'`). `[ldap.corp]` binds as the read-only `Reader`, so a write needs another account.
`Core\Ldap\Entries::references` and `total`, and `Core\Ldap\Changes::cookie`, owe every proof; `total` and `cookie` also owe a Rust test with a `covers:` line.
`Core\Ldap\Ad\AccountFlags` and `Core\Ldap\Ad\GroupType` (`bits`, `with`, `mustChangePassword`, `security`) owe every proof but tests.
Every `Core\Ldap\Entry` bench records about 4.6 µs per call, which is the connect and TLS handshake spread over the loop; the counts are right and the clock is not (`benches/members/README.md`).
Stage 4: a CA a program supplies to `Ldap::open` (`docs/agent/goals/ldap.md`).
Stage 6: the schema wired into the readers (`docs/agent/goals/ldap.md`).
